items.title: Bangkok Deep Bored Pile Acoustic Uniformity Verification & Debonding Diagnosis
items.location: Bangkok Metropolitan Area (Chao Phraya Soft Clay Basin)
items.scope: Crosshole Sonic Logging (CSL) across 4 access tubes on 1,500 mm diameter bored piles (depth 55 m). Acoustic first arrival time (FAT) and relative energy attenuation profiling to resolve apparent signal drops at 18 m depth.
items.deliverables: Full-depth acoustic velocity profiles, waterfall B-scan plots, diagnosis distinguishing tube debonding from true concrete honeycombing, Thai Licensed PE stamped evaluation report.

items.title: Rayong EEC Industrial Facility 600-Ton Static Pile Load Test (SLT) & Reaction Frame Coordination
items.scope: Axial compressive static load test on 600 mm prestressed concrete spun piles to 200% design working load (6,000 kN). Reaction kentledge and anchor pile frame design verification, digital LVDT settlement monitoring, calibrated hydraulic jack setup.
items.deliverables: Load-settlement-time curves, Davisson failure criterion analysis, elastic rebound measurement, and statutory pile acceptance certification.

items.title: Industrial Warehouse Heavy Structural Steel Sourcing, Mill Traceability & Factory QA/QC Audit
items.scope: Independent buyer-side procurement oversight for 1,200 metric tons of welded H-beams, box columns, and truss components. Normalized RFQ package, shop capacity and welding procedure qualification (WPS/PQR) audit across 4 candidate fabricators.
items.deliverables: Comprehensive supplier comparison matrix, heat number and Mill Test Certificate (MTC) traceability ledger, dry-film thickness (DFT) paint log, and pre-shipment inspection release dossier.

items.title: Mineral Grinding & Industrial Dust Collection Technical Boundary Coordination
items.scope: Process duty requirement alignment for a 45 t/h mineral powder grinding system. Preliminary sizing for Vertical Roller Mill (VRM), high-efficiency dynamic separator, and pulse-jet baghouse dust collector with air-to-cloth ratio verification.
items.deliverables: Process duty parameter sheet, technical deviation list, battery-limit definition, and manufacturer-confirmed supply scope coordination with CNBM (Hefei) Powder Technology.
